new_treasure_maps.tip_perspective: I swear by Davy Jones, our precious booty be buried no further than fifty blocks from the very coffer where ye fished out this parchment, shiver me timbers!
new_treasure_maps.tip_dotted_line: Drop yer anchor at the chest holdin' the map—that be where yer voyage begins! And mind ye, landlubber: the span betwixt the lines be exactly one block of a pace, arrr!
new_treasure_maps.tip_drawn: The sweet loot sleeps in the dirt right beneath that oak bearin' the cross! Keep yer good eye peeled, sailor: this tree be a peculiar one, ain't like yer regular timber growin' around these parts! Dig there, or ye'll be feedin' the sharks!
new_treasure_maps.tip_area: The piastres be stashed somewhere in that blood-red patch! Keep yer good eye pealed fer a cross on the soil and dig till yer shovel splinters against the lid, blast it all!
